stage_reasons.implement: Parent implementation/write ownership belongs to the baseline engineering model.
stage_reasons.converge: Convergence is a semantic correctness gate and may require deeper reasoning.
stage_reasons.checklist-converge: Requirements-quality repair is semantic work owned by the parent model.
stage_reasons.implement-review: The parent orchestrates convergence, fixes and reviewer handoffs; the deep reviewer remains a separate Sol/xhigh role.
stage_reasons.full-cycle: The full cycle is orchestration over multiple SpecKit stages and should stay on the baseline parent model.
stage_reasons.debt-create: Debt creation changes authoritative backlog state and requires semantic judgment.
stage_reasons.debt-list: Read-only inventory/filtering is bounded mechanical work.
stage_reasons.debt-consult: Read-only exact-ID/provenance lookup is bounded mechanical work.
stage_reasons.debt-start: Starting debt work changes lifecycle state and requires readiness judgment.
stage_reasons.debt-close: Closure changes lifecycle state and requires evidence-backed semantic judgment.
stage_reasons.powerpack-update: Update discovery is bounded operational work.
